articles.summary: Dear Duchenne Community, Today at the 2026 MDA Clinical & Scientific Conference, we announced a positive clinical update on the SGT-003 gene therapy program. This update includes interim safety and biomarker data from the ongoing Phase 1/2 INSPIRE DUCHENNE clinical trial. To date, 40 participants have been dosed with SGT-003.
